name: 03_config_malformed_line_before_key
why: The env file is written by hand, by setup scripts and by key rotation, so it can contain a merge leftover or a comment without `#`. Aborting the parse on a bad line would discard the key on the NEXT line - trading one problem for a worse one. Both loaders must skip the junk and keep going.

env_file_lines: this line has no equals sign at all

on_failure: A loader that reports fingerprint "" here aborts on the malformed line and drops every variable after it. That is silent config loss: the file looks right to a human and the plugin persists nothing.
